name: Kirishima Kazuki
source:
The protagonist of this game. 
The second son of the Kirishima family. He is enrolled in a university in Tokyo, but after the unexpected death of his older brother, who inherited the family assets at a young age after the passing of their parents, he suddenly becomes the new head of the household. He has never been good at socializing and has no interest in extravagant partying. He relied heavily on his only remaining relative, his older brother, and for this reason he was hardly involved in household matters and is ignorant in the ways of the world.
He has a gentle personality and isn't used to doubting people, but this ultimately leads to him allowing the outrageous actions of the four visitors. According to Mimasaka, he is "prettier than most girls."

[Translated from [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/pigeon/]Official site[/url] and [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/PigeonBlood]Wikipedia[/url]]
